mapper.sql: SELECT i.item_id, i.order_id, i.session_id, i.student_id, i.price, i.status, s.lesson_id, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.status AS session_status FROM order_item i JOIN lesson_session s ON s.session_id = i.session_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, session_id, student_id, price, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{price}, #{status})
mapper.select: WHERE i.session_id = #{sessionId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.order_id
WHERE i.student_id = #{studentId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.start_at

SELECT i.item_id, i.order_id, i.session_id, i.student_id, i.price, i.status, s.lesson_id, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.status AS session_status, l.title AS lesson_title, o.status AS order_status, o.payment_status FROM order_item i JOIN lesson_session s ON s.session_id = i.session_id JOIN lesson l ON l.lesson_id = s.lesson_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE i.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.start_at, i.item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE item_id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
